messages.text: I’m using the JavaFX app scaffolding skill to set up Gymmie with the expected project structure and build configuration.

The repository is effectively empty, and JDK 25 is available. The system Gradle launcher is currently failing before startup due to a macOS native-library issue, so I’ll scaffold the project files directly, then use the generated wrapper for verification and diagnose any remaining environment issue.

I confirmed the Gradle wrapper can be generated when Gradle uses the repository-local cache, so the earlier failure is isolated to the default home cache permissions. I’m now adding the minimal Gymmie scene, tests, quality checks, documentation, and CI configuration.

The project skeleton is in place and the Gradle 9.7.1 wrapper has been generated successfully. I’m running the full checks and fat-JAR build now; if the desktop launch is blocked by the CI-style headless environment, I’ll separate that environment limitation from project failures.

The first verification exposed two configuration issues, both straightforward: Checkstyle was treating field documentation as violations, and Gradle 9.7.1 needs the JUnit Platform launcher explicitly on the test runtime classpath. I’m correcting those and rerunning the checks.

`./gradlew check` and `./gradlew shadowJar` now pass, and the fat JAR is produced. The attempted GUI launch reached JavaFX but the current runner exposes no display/screen, so it cannot create a window here; that is an environment limitation rather than a compile or packaging failure. I’m doing a final file/artifact audit.

Set up Gymmie as a JavaFX desktop app with:

- Java 25, Gradle 9.7.1, JavaFX 25
- Starter FXML scene with CSS styling
- JUnit 5, Checkstyle, JaCoCo, and Shadow
- GitHub Actions workflow
- README, AGENTS.md, and `.gitignore`

Verification passed:

- `./gradlew check`
- `./gradlew shadowJar`
- Fat JAR: [Gymmie-1.0.0-all.jar](/Users/shawnnygoh/github-repos/CS3227-2610-MP2/build/libs/Gymmie-1.0.0-all.jar)

The GUI launch was blocked only because this environment has no available display/screen.

---
name: create-javafx-app
description: Scaffold a new JavaFX desktop app with a small, consistent project structure.
---

## When to use this

Use when you need to set up a new JavaFX desktop app.

## What to build

Create a JavaFX project and add a starter scene as an entry point. Keep it minimal.

## Prerequisites

- JDK 25
- Gradle 9.7.1
- A GitHub repository already initialized

## Steps

1. Scaffold the JavaFX app with Gradle by running `gradle :wrapper --gradle-version 9.7.1` and apply the necessary plugins (e.g. OpenJFX JavaFX Plugin 0.1.0, Gradle Shadow 9.6.1).

2. Add style checks following the se-education.org Java coding standard.

3. Add Jacoco for measuring code coverage.

4. Add Shadow Gradle and verify that `./gradlew shadowJar` produces a runnable fat jar.

5. Add JUnit 5 and write one trivial test.

6. Create App.java, Launcher.java, MainController.java and MainWindow.fxml which contains a minimal UI with a title label that displays the app's name. Style the UI with CSS.

7. Add a GitHub Actions workflow that checks out the repo, sets up the JDK and runs `./gradlew check`.

8. Add AGENTS.md which includes the tech stack, build commands (`./gradlew run`, `./gradlew check`, `./gradlew shadowJar`), code style convention, and git convention.

9. Add a minimal README.md which includes the project name, a one-line description, and how to build and run the app.

10. Add a .gitignore which excludes any `build/`, `.gradle/` or IDE folders.

## Project structure after setup

- src/
    - main/java/<package>/
        - App.java
        - MainController.java
        - Launcher.java (entry)
    - main/resources/<package>/
        - view/
            - MainWindow.fxml (root UI)
        - css/
            - <package>.css
    - test/java/<package>/
        - TrivialTest.java
- gradle/
    - wrapper/
        - gradle-wrapper.jar
        - gradle-wrapper.properties
- config/
    - checkstyle/
        - checkstyle.xml
        - suppressions.xml
- build.gradle
- settings.gradle
- gradlew.bat
- gradlew
- README.md
- AGENTS.md
- .gitignore
- .github/workflows/gradle.yml

## Definition of done

- `./gradlew run` launches the application window without errors
- `./gradlew check` passes (Checkstyle and tests both pass)
- `./gradlew shadowJar` produces a runnable fat jar in `build/libs/`
- All files mentioned in the project structure above exist
